8512-the-three-cities-trilogy-lourdes-vo.title: Lourdes
8512-the-three-cities-trilogy-lourdes-vo.creator: Unknown
8512-the-three-cities-trilogy-lourdes-vo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He lived, indeed, in a state of high fever throughout the period of the great pilgrimages. Apart from the usual service, he that day expected eighteen trains, containing more than fifteen thousand passengers. The grey and the blue trains which had started from Paris the first had already arrived at the regulation hour.

arxiv-1709-07535.title: Prediction of trending topics using ANFIS and deterministic models
arxiv-1709-07535.creator: René Escalante, Marco Odehnal
arxiv-1709-07535.description: Abstract Trending topics are often the result of the spreading of information between users of social networks. These special topics can be regarded as rumors. The spreading of a rumor is often studied with the same techniques as in epidemics spreading.

arxiv-2012-01863.title: First order transition in trigonal structure Ca Mn 2 ​ P 2 {\textbf{Ca}}{\textbf{Mn}}_{2}{\textbf{P}}_{2}
arxiv-2012-01863.creator: Y. J. Li, F. Jin, Z. Y. Mi, J. Guo, W. Wu, Z. H. Yu, D. S. Wu, S. H. Na, C. Mu, X. B. Zhou, Z. Li, K. Liu, L. L. Sun, Q. M. Zhang, T. Xiang, G. Li, J. L. Luo
arxiv-2012-01863.description: Abstract We report structural and physical properties of the single crystalline CaMn 2 ​ P 2 {\mathrm{Ca}}{\mathrm{Mn}}_{2}{\mathrm{P}}_{2} . The X-ray diffraction(XRD) results show that CaMn 2 ​ P 2 {\mathrm{Ca}}{\mathrm{Mn}}_{2}{\mathrm{P}}_{2} adopts the trigonal CaAl 2 ​ Si 2 {\mathrm{Ca}}{\mathrm{Al}}_{2}{\mathrm{Si}}_{2} -type structure.

arxiv-2012-11123.title: Generator coordinate method with a conjugate momentum: application to the particle number projection
arxiv-2012-11123.creator: N. Hizawa, K. Hagino, K. Yoshida
arxiv-2012-11123.description: Abstract We discuss an extension of the generator coordinate method (GCM) by taking simultaneously a collective coordinate and its conjugate momentum as generator coordinates. To this end, we follow the idea of the dynamical GCM (DGCM) proposed by Goeke and Reinhard.

arxiv-2106-02547.title: Flux recovery for Cut finite element method and its application in a posteriori error estimation Thanks: This work was funded by the EPSRC grant EP/P01576X/1.

arxiv-2106-02547.description: Abstract In this article, we aim to recover locally conservative and H ⁡ ( d ​ i ​ v ) H(div) conforming fluxes for the linear Cut Finite Element Solution with Nitsche’s method for Poisson problems with Dirichlet boundary condition.

arxiv-2112-13090.title: Search for resonances decaying to three \PW bosons in the hadronic final state in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2112-13090.description: Abstract A search for Kaluza–Klein excited vector boson resonances, \PW KK \PW_{\mathrm{KK}} , decaying in cascade to three \PW bosons via a scalar radion \HepParticle R, \PW KK → \PW ​ \HepParticle ​ R → \PW ​ \PW ​ \PW \PW_{\mathrm{KK}}\to\PW{\HepParticle{R}{}{}}\to\PW\PW\PW , in a final state containing two or three massive jets is presented.

arxiv-2208-11546.title: Unsupervised Structure-Consistent Image-to-Image Translation
arxiv-2208-11546.creator: Shima Shahfar, Charalambos Poullis
arxiv-2208-11546.description: Abstract The Swapping Autoencoder achieved state-of-the-art performance in deep image manipulation and image-to-image translation. We improve this work by introducing a simple yet effective auxiliary module based on gradient reversal layers. The auxiliary module’s loss forces the generator to learn to reconstruct an image with an all-zero texture code, encouraging better disentanglement between the structure and texture information.

arxiv-2209-13079.title: On Three-Valued Modal Logics: from a Four-Valued Perspective
arxiv-2209-13079.creator: Xinyu Wang, Yang Song, Satoshi Tojo
arxiv-2209-13079.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Wang, Yang Song, Satoshi Tojo. This paper aims at providing a comprehensive solution to the archaic open problem: how to define semantics of three-valued modal logic with vivid intuitive picture, convincing philosophical justification as well as versatile practical usage.

This improves upon current common deconvolution fitting methods, which often produce inaccurate spectra.

arxiv-2312-00711.title: Thick points of 4D critical branching Brownian motion
arxiv-2312-00711.creator: Nathanaël Berestycki, Tom Hutchcroft, Antoine Jego
arxiv-2312-00711.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nathanaël Berestycki, Tom Hutchcroft, Antoine Jego. We study the thick points of branching Brownian motion and branching random walk with a critical branching mechanism, focusing on the critical dimension d = 4 d=4 .

arxiv-2312-08913.title: Complete Embeddings of Groups
arxiv-2312-08913.creator: Martin R. Bridson, Hamish Short
arxiv-2312-08913.description: Abstract . Every countable group G G can be embedded in a finitely generated group G ∗ G^{*} that is hopfian and complete , i.e. G ∗ G^{*} has trivial centre and every epimorphism G ∗ → G ∗ G^{*}\to G^{*} is an inner automorphism.

The toric ideal I A I_{A} is splittable if it has a toric splitting; namely, if there exist toric ideals I A 1 , I A 2 I_{A_{1}},I_{A_{2}} such that I A = I A 1 + I A 2 I_{A}=I_{A_{1}}+I_{A_{2}} and I A i ≠ I A I_{A_{i}}\not=I_{A} for all 1 ≤ i ≤ 2 1\leq i\leq 2 .

arxiv-2411-04364.title: Efficient Localization of Directional Emitters via Joint Beampattern Estimation
arxiv-2411-04364.creator: FRASER WILLIAMS, AKILA PEMASIRI, DHAMMIKA JAYALATH, TERRENCE MARTIN, CLINTON FOOKES
arxiv-2411-04364.description: Abstract Localization methods designed for omnidirectional emitters degrade on directional sources, where directive beampatterns induce pronounced received signal strength (RSS) modulations. We present a direct position determination (DPD) approach that augments standard angle of arrival (AOA) and time difference of arrival (TDOA) measurements with RSS modulation to jointly estimate emitter position and beampattern parameters.

arxiv-2412-09540.title: Discretely self-similar exterior-naked singularities for the Einstein-scalar field system
arxiv-2412-09540.creator: Serban Cicortas, Christoph Kehle
arxiv-2412-09540.description: Abstract The problem of constructing naked singularities in general relativity can be naturally divided into two parts: (i) the construction of the region exterior to the past light cone of the singularity, extending all the way to (an incomplete) future null infinity and yielding the nakedness property (what we will call exterior-naked singularity regions ) (ii) attaching an interior fill-in

arxiv-2502-13523.title: An application of the mean motion problem to time-optimal control
arxiv-2502-13523.creator: Omri Dalin, Alexander Ovseevich, Michael Margaliot
arxiv-2502-13523.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Omri Dalin, Alexander Ovseevich, Michael Margaliot. We consider time-optimal controls of a controllable linear system with a scalar control on a long time interval. It is well-known that if all the eigenvalues of the matrix describing the linear system dynamics are real then any time-optimal control has a bounded number of switching points, where the bound does not depend on the length of the time interval.

arxiv-2601-01634.title: Boundary control systems on a one-dimensional spatial domain Thanks: Submitted to the editors on December 30 , 2025.
arxiv-2601-01634.creator: Bouchra Elghazi, Birgit Jacob, Hans Zwart
arxiv-2601-01634.description: Abstract The aim of this paper is to investigate the well-posedness of a class of boundary control and observation systems on a one dimensional spatial domain. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition characterizing the well-posedness of these systems. Furthermore, we show that the well-posedness and full control and observation implies exact controllability and exact observability.

Here we report empirical evidence that...

pmc-11445940.title: A genome-wide association study reveals molecular mechanism underlying powdery mildew resistance in cucumber
pmc-11445940.creator: Xuewen Xu, Yujiao Du, Suhao Li, Ming Tan, Hamza Sohail, Xueli Liu, Xiaohua Qi, Xiaodong Yang, Xuehao Chen
pmc-11445940.description: BackgroundPowdery mildew is a disease with one of the most substantial impacts on cucumber production globally. The most efficient approach for controlling powdery mildew is the development of genetic resistance; however, few genes associated with inherent variations in cucumber powdery mildew resistance have been identified as of yet.

pmc-12366044.title: Determinants of breastfeeding initiation in thailand: multiple indicator cluster survey analysis
pmc-12366044.creator: Salila Cetthakrikul, Chompoonut Topothai, Nisachol Cetthakrikul
pmc-12366044.description: BackgroundEarly initiation of breastfeeding, defined as breastfeeding within one hour of birth, is a critical indicator of optimal infant feeding practices with substantial health benefits for mothers and infants. Early initiation of breastfeeding rates in Thailand has declined over the past decade, necessitating an investigation into the underlying determinants.

pmc-12413023.title: The Organization of Central Retinal Projections in Anna's Hummingbirds (Calypte anna) and Zebra Finches (Taeniopygia castanotis)
pmc-12413023.creator: Cristián Gutiérrez‐Ibáñez, Julia A Bowen, Andrea H Gaede, Douglas L Altshuler, Douglas R Wylie
pmc-12413023.description: Hummingbirds (family Trochilidae) are easily recognized due to their unique ability to hover. Critical to hovering flight is head and body stabilization. In birds, stabilization during flight is mediated, among other things, by the detection of optic flow, the motion that occurs across the entire retina during self‐motion.

pmc-12613591.title: The lung cancer-associated blood biomarker hPG80 exhibits a reversible increase in response to smoking in asymptomatic individuals
pmc-12613591.creator: Bérengère Vire, Léa Payen, Claire Vignault, Véronique Hofman, Charles Hugo Marquette, Jean-Philippe Berthet, Jacques Boutros, Marius Ilie, Guillaume Penaranda, Philippe Pourquier, Nassima Mimoun, Dominique Joubert, Alexandre Prieur, Paul Hofman
pmc-12613591.description: The blood biomarker hPG80 is linked to multiple solid tumors, including lung cancer. This study examined blood hPG80 levels of asymptomatic individuals and patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), categorized by their smoking and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) status.

pmc-12644872.title: Finite element analysis of engine pistons: comparative assessment of aluminium and titanium alloys under combined thermal-structural loading
pmc-12644872.creator: Elias Wakshume, Gadisa Sufe
pmc-12644872.description: Finite Element Analysis (ANSYS 19.2) was used to compare four piston materials — Aluminium 7075, Aluminium 2618, Aluminium 4032 and Titanium Ti-6Al-4 V — under combined mechanical and thermal loading. The study reports steady-state thermal and static structural snapshots for comparison.

pmc-13173096.title: 78 Automated ML pipeline for analysis of paraesophageal hernias
pmc-13173096.creator: Sharon A Lee, Rakesh Sharma, Walter R Witschey, Maria S Altieri, Victoria M Gershuni, David A Mankoff, Daniel A Hashimoto
pmc-13173096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives/Goals: In patients with paraesophageal hernia (PEH), evaluate associations between CT radiomic features and clinical data with (1) undergoing elective repair and (2) volvulus/gastric outlet obstruction and develop an ML pipeline for automated feature extraction and prognosis estimation. Methods/Study Population: Retrospective case–control of adults (>18) at Penn Medicine (2017–2025) with hiatal hernia ICD-9/10 codes and CT chest or CT abdomen/pelvis from clinical care. Radiology reports, H&P, and operative notes will be used to identify those with PEH.

pmc-13503129.title: ReliST: A model-agnostic risk layer for spatial transcriptomics deconvolution
pmc-13503129.creator: Xinyu Zhang, Li He, Yu Peng, Yijia Li, Jianyuan Kang, Lisheng Peng, Yifei Xu, Sen Lin
pmc-13503129.description: SummarySpatial transcriptomics deconvolution maps cell-type abundance across tissue, but most outputs do not indicate which local predictions can be trusted. We developed ReliST, a model-agnostic risk layer that preserves base predictions while assigning spot-level risk from output ambiguity, local inconsistency, and reference-related evidence.

pmc-13609881.title: Astaxanthin–Turmeric–Honeysuckle Extract Combination Attenuates DSS-Induced Colitis with Preservation of the Epithelial Barrier and Reduced NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD Signaling
pmc-13609881.creator: Zhongting Lv, Xuan Liu, Yong Pang, Jie Zhang, Li Ren
pmc-13609881.description: Inflammatory bowel disease is characterized by recurrent mucosal inflammation, epithelial barrier disruption, and dysregulated cell death, highlighting the need for safe, multi-target interventions. Natural astaxanthin, renewably sourced from Haematococcus pluvialis or Phaffia rhodozyma, has shown greater tissue accumulation or antioxidant activity than synthetic astaxanthin in some preparations.
